Package index

Build & assemble

Turn a processed Seurat object into an on-disk project, and attach reprocessed sub-embeddings as linked views.

scroll_build()
Build a scroll project from a Seurat object
scroll_build_stream()
Build a scroll project by streaming many sources (large-dataset build)
scroll_update()
Add or update reductions / metadata on a built project (no expr rebuild)
scroll_add_meta()
Add (or replace) a metadata column in a built project – no Seurat object needed
scroll_add_subset()
Attach a reprocessed subset onto a parent object
vdj_spec()
Describe a dataset's TCR/BCR (VDJ) metadata for scroll_build()
spatial_spec()
Describe a dataset's spatial image + coordinates for scroll_build()
atac_spec()
Describe a dataset's scATAC peaks assay for scroll_build()

Run the app

Launch the runtime explorer, or preview a single panel while developing it.

scroll_app()
Build the scroll explorer app
scroll_multi_app()
Build a multi-dataset scroll explorer
scroll_serve()
Run the scroll explorer locally
scroll_preview_panel()
Preview a single panel while developing it

Query layer

The flat-RAM arrow query interface, usable programmatically without the app.

scroll_connect()
Open a scroll project for querying
scroll_disconnect()
Close a scroll project handle
scroll_manifest()
Read a scroll project manifest
scroll_query_feature()
Query one feature's expression from the Parquet store
scroll_query_features()
Query several features at once
scroll_dequantize()
Map stored (possibly quantized) values back to normalized expression

Differential expression

Live Wilcoxon markers and replicate-aware pseudobulk testing.

scroll_de()
Live differential expression for a contrast (presto / Wilcoxon)
scroll_pseudobulk_de()
Pseudobulk differential expression (edgeR / limma-voom)

Extend the app

Register custom panels — declaratively from a plot function plus declared controls, or with the low-level module contract the built-ins use.

register_plot_panel()
Register a plot panel declaratively (no Shiny boilerplate)
register_panel()
Register a custom panel in the scroll explorer
scroll_input_column() scroll_input_levels() scroll_input_gene() scroll_input_numeric() scroll_input_slider() scroll_input_choice() scroll_input_text() scroll_input_palette() scroll_input_assay() scroll_input_embedding() scroll_input_custom()
Declarative controls for register_plot_panel()
scroll_show_when()
Show a control only when another control has a given value
scroll_style_input()
Put a control in the plot's Style sheet
scroll_point_layer() scroll_discrete_colors() scroll_continuous_scale() scroll_group_labels()
Reusable plotting helpers for custom views
scroll_render_plot()
Wire a plot output with error surfacing and PNG/PDF downloads
scroll_columns()
Metadata columns of a given type
scroll_embeddings()
Embeddings (reductions) available in a scroll project
scroll_features()
Features (e.g. genes) of an assay in a scroll project
scroll_reset_panels()
Clear all custom panels registered with register_panel()
